page.overview:
What is Images Comics?

Image Comics is the independent comic book organization that runs comics such as the original comic Invincible, Capes Inc, and Battle Beast, it was founded by Todd McFarlane, Jim Lee and other former marvel artists.

In 1992, a group of highly professional illustrators led by Todd McFarlane came together and founded Image Comics, creating well received comics like Spawn, Youngblood, and more.

They were published by Mailbu Comics at the time and their first comic series was Youngblood in April of 1992, managing to get over 900k copies, followed by Spawn, Savage Dragon. Another which was Tribe that became the company's largest selling african american comic book title at the time.

For the next few years, each series managed to sell around 500,000 copies per issue. In later years, the company would recieve several incidents with a market collapse, and distributions which began an unbalance within the founders. Liefield proposed a type of merger, with other comic companies,
